summary_en: Takamatsu Machinery authorized acquisition of up to 520,000 shares (4.8% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥300 million from November 10, 2026 to March 31, 2027, to enhance capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, Takamatsu Machinery's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury shares based on Article 165(2) of the Companies Act and the company's articles of incorporation. The authorization permits the company to acquire up to 520,000 shares (4.8% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum expenditure of ¥300 million. The acquisition period runs from November 10, 2026 to March 31, 2027.

The company stated that the buyback aims to enhance capital efficiency, enable flexible execution of capital policy, and serve as part of its shareholder return strategy. As of October 31, 2026, the company held 211,501 treasury shares, with 10,808,499 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock. The specific acquisition method (ToSTNeT-3, open market purchase, or off-exchange transaction) was not disclosed in the notice.
